data.one_liner: Flutter shared_preferences plugin utility supporting default values and objects.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the shared_preferences plugin to make it easier to store and retrieve primitive data types, objects, and object lists. It provides helper methods for key management, defaults, and saving custom serializable objects.
use_when: You want a simpler utility wrapper around shared_preferences
You need to easily serialize and store custom objects or lists of objects into key-value storage
avoid_when: You require secure encrypted local storage
You need complex relational queries or high-performance local databases
strengths: Supports saving and retrieving custom objects and object lists directly
weaknesses: Relies on global static initialization which may require careful app startup flow
Shared preferences is not suitable for large or secure datasets
data.setup_notes: Must call await SpUtil.getInstance() before running the app.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official plugin without the extra wrapper methods provided by sp_util.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a faster NoSQL key-value storage alternative with built-in object adapters.
